title: Seven distinct browser tools for একটুখানি
scope: Public primary-source discovery and product feasibility; no app code or third-party artwork copied.
conclusion: Build seven different interaction models: paint regions, edit repeat grids, solve letter tiles, crop and arrange photos, compose type, settle shared costs, and edit a weekly time grid. Cultural recognition and competing products establish relevance or precedent; they do not establish demand for this implementation.
limitations: No representative Bangladesh Facebook dataset or new Google Trends measurements were obtained. No viral probability or population-wide preference is estimated.
Store download buckets are worldwide platform counts, not Bangladeshi active users. Reviews and vendor popularity claims are not independently audited.

Search results can be stale: the ShobdoJot listing initially showed 4.5/202 reviews, while the directly opened page showed 4.4/344. The stable 10K+ download bucket is retained; no growth rate is inferred.

UNESCO Jamdani's canonical page returned a human-verification interstitial on direct open; the official indexed description and Bangladesh reporting page remain cultural context, not current usage evidence.
PhotoCardBD /index could not be reopened, but the root homepage and public instructions were accessible. No opaque frame counter is treated as verified downloads.
No global uniqueness claim. No commercial site's frames, photographs, puzzle database, logo, or code has a verified reuse grant here.
rankingBasis: Editorial prioritization of interaction depth, distinction from the existing 13 tools, useful outputs, and practical browser implementation—not a numerical market forecast.

recommendations.name: রিকশার রং
recommendations.interaction: Paint a complete original rickshaw rear panel: tap regions to fill, place original bird/flower/sun motifs, resize or mirror selected motifs, undo and reset.
recommendations.output: PNG panel plus optional printable colouring outline; share a design challenge with friends.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Strong Bangladesh cultural relevance; no verified traffic for a browser painter.
recommendations.hypothesis: Directly making a panel is more engaging than choosing a name-card theme.
recommendations.differentiation: A region-and-stamp painting surface, rather than the existing scene builder or a name-only rickshaw generator.
recommendations.minimumVersion: One original outlined panel, 8 colours, 6 original stamps, selection, delete, undo, PNG.
recommendations.resources: Draw original SVG artwork. UNESCO photographs are references only. Do not copy cinema characters or a living artist's panel.
recommendations.avoid: Do not call a simplified editor an authentic artisan technique, or claim proceeds support artists without an arrangement.

recommendations.name: নকশার বুনন
recommendations.interaction: Tap or drag across a 12×12 cell grid; erase, mirror, undo and see the motif repeat live across a fabric-like preview.
recommendations.output: Seamless repeat PNG and a numbered A4 grid for making an original paper or stitch pattern.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Cultural relevance plus a globally established pixel-editor mechanism; no Bangladesh demand measurement.
recommendations.hypothesis: A small mobile-friendly repeat editor can turn passive pattern browsing into making and exchanging patterns.
recommendations.differentiation: Direct cell editing and tiling, distinct from alpana's radial motif composition.
recommendations.minimumVersion: Two or three colours, fixed grid, repeat preview, horizontal mirror, erase, undo, clear, PNG and print.
recommendations.resources: Original grid data and generated geometry. Piskel is Apache-2.0 if code is ever reused, but a small independent grid avoids importing its desktop-oriented editor.
recommendations.avoid: Label the product original grid patterns, not authentic Jamdani weaving instructions.

recommendations.name: শব্দ সাজাই
recommendations.interaction: Read an original clue, tap grapheme-safe Bengali tiles into answer slots, move a tile back, request a hint and check the answer.
recommendations.output: Spoiler-free results card and challenge number; practice can be replayed without account or payment.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Best direct local category signal: Bangladesh developer listing with 10K+ worldwide downloads, updated 2026-08-06. This is not evidence of Bangladesh active-user scale.
recommendations.hypothesis: A short free clue puzzle can attract repeat sessions and friendly sharing without money rewards.
recommendations.differentiation: An actual playable digital puzzle, unlike the existing offline-game selector.
recommendations.minimumVersion: 20–30 original reviewed everyday clues; pre-segmented answer tiles preserving vowel signs/conjuncts; deterministic challenge selection; reset and score.
recommendations.resources: Author a small original clue/answer list. Shobdle and MinhasKamal/BengaliDictionary are GPL-3.0; do not silently copy them into the product.
recommendations.avoid: Do not use competitor branding, promise learning outcomes or offer cash/prizes. Reviews include conflicting payout claims; no accusation or earning mechanism is adopted.

recommendations.name: সপ্তাহের ছক
recommendations.interaction: Select day and time, create coloured blocks, edit or move them, copy a day and flag overlapping time blocks.
recommendations.output: Phone-friendly weekly image and A4 landscape routine with a clear legend.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: A Bangladesh institution publishes class routines dated 2026-01-07; evidence of the scheduling workflow, not usage of a planner.
recommendations.hypothesis: Editable visual routines can help students and families share a legible plan in a group chat.
recommendations.differentiation: Recurring weekly time placement, distinct from the deadline tracker and one-off outing planner.
recommendations.minimumVersion: Seven editable days, user-entered times, 20 bounded blocks, colour categories, overlap detection, copy-day, print/PNG.
recommendations.resources: User-entered events and original layout. Link official institution schedules as examples; do not republish their PDFs or claim live institutional data.
recommendations.avoid: No automated school timetable, official holidays, notifications, or external calendar sync promised.

recommendations.name: ভাগাভাগি
recommendations.interaction: Add 2–8 people and expenses with payer; edit or remove entries; see each person's paid amount, equal share, net balance and deterministic settlement arrows immediately.
recommendations.output: Copyable Bengali settlement report and downloaded text file for a friend or family group.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Official bKash supports group payment workflows. Splitwise self-reports millions of groups and a 2025–2026 dataset; global evidence, not Bangladesh demand.
recommendations.hypothesis: An account-free, Bengali, visibly transparent balance calculation is useful when one person is collecting a group's numbers.
recommendations.differentiation: Who-owes-whom accounting across multiple payers; existing বাজার নোট totals one shopping list.
recommendations.minimumVersion: Equal allocation among all named people, exact integer poisha, explicit deterministic remainder rule, editable expenses, zero-sum balances and settlement report.
recommendations.resources: Original arithmetic and SVG/CSS bars; existing Bengali font. No financial-service code, logos, transaction APIs or credentials needed.
recommendations.avoid: No payment, debt collection, synchronization, financial advice or claim that the transfer list is mathematically minimal.

recommendations.name: ছবি জোড়া
recommendations.interaction: Choose 2–6 local photos, rearrange slots, crop and zoom each photo, rotate, change gaps and corner shape; see changes immediately.
recommendations.output: Flattened PNG/JPEG collage for printing or sharing; optional short Bengali caption.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Two Bangladesh-facing products advertise photo editing. No independent traffic or Bangladesh user count verified.
recommendations.hypothesis: A focused local-only photo workflow can be useful if it is faster and clearer than existing suites.
recommendations.differentiation: Manipulates the user's actual photos; existing memory cards and dialect cards use curated illustrations.
recommendations.minimumVersion: Three original layouts, drag/reorder buttons, per-photo crop/zoom, swap slots, remove, reset and raster download.
recommendations.resources: Only user-selected images and original frames; canvas processing in browser. Keep EXIF or file contents out of server uploads. Competitor frames are not reusable assets.
recommendations.avoid: No AI background removal, cloud backup, collaboration or uniqueness claim. PosterBD already advertises six-photo collages.

recommendations.name: লেখার পোস্টার
recommendations.interaction: Compose a short Bengali heading and supporting line; directly adjust alignment, scale, line spacing, colours, outline/shadow and text position within print-safe bounds.
recommendations.output: Original typographic PNG and A4 print poster for a club notice, personal message or room.
recommendations.evidenceAssessment: Local competitor precedent and an openly licensed Bengali display font; specific demand remains untested.
recommendations.hypothesis: A typography-first workspace may be useful if it offers meaningful control beyond name input and theme selection.
recommendations.differentiation: Editable type composition and layout, not another recoloured card or dialect-object label.
recommendations.minimumVersion: One main and one supporting text block, keyboard-friendly positioning, three original compositions, colour/size/alignment controls, PNG.
recommendations.resources: Existing self-hosted Bengali font is sufficient. Atma is a Bengali/Latin display family under OFL-1.1; if added, ship its copyright/license and preserve font naming conditions.
recommendations.avoid: Do not copy branded news-card layouts or third-party quotations/templates. This is the lowest-differentiation candidate and should be tested first with a simple prototype.

validationPlan: For each editor, observe whether a person can make one distinct output and find download without instruction; capture completion and error counts only with explicit test participation.
Test Bengali labels, conjunct rendering, keyboard controls, mobile touch targets, reduced-motion preferences and PNG/print output.
Share only user-chosen output; no hidden public gallery, upload, contact collection or automatic Facebook posting.
Measure actual repeat use and voluntary sharing after release before describing any idea as viral or proven.
